youtube.title: Why does your phone race to 80%, then crawl? 🔋 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Phones charge quickly at first because the battery is mostly empty and can accept a large current. Near the top, lithium ions have fewer places to go, so the charger lowers the current and holds the voltage steady. Pushing full power into a nearly full lithium-ion battery would heat it and wear it out faster. The slow last stretch protects the battery's lifespan.
